project_type: Next.js 16.3.5 (App Router) with React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion, Swiper
test_framework: None configured — verify manually by running dev server and checking pages
test_command: npm run dev (manual verification at http://localhost:3000)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run dev' 2. Navigate to each country page URL 3. Verify all 10 components render 4. Check [guide] dynamic routes 5. Inspect for console errors 6. Verify responsive behavior (mobile/tablet/desktop)
environment_constraints: Next.js 16.3.5 may have breaking changes from training data — heed AGENTS.md warning. Do not restart dev server if already running on :3000. All components use 'use client' directive. Image paths use /images/ structure.
contribution_requirements: Follow Next.js App Router conventions. Use metadata export for SEO. All interactive components must have 'use client' directive. Match existing code style: 2-space indentation, double quotes for JSX attributes, arrow functions for components.
key_patterns: Country pages follow pattern: app/study-in-{country}/page.js imports from components/StudyIn{Country}/ folder. 10 components per country: Hero, OnlineDegreeSection, WhatItGetsYou, CoursesSlider, HowUniversityYatraHelps, UniversityCarousel, CostOfStudying{Country}, Testimonials, GlobalEducationCTA. [guide] pages use dynamic routes with notFound() for invalid slugs.
directory_structure: frontend/app/ - Next.js App Router pages. frontend/components/ - Organized by feature (StudyInCanada, StudyInIreland, etc.). frontend/public/images/ - Static assets including country hero images, universities, courses, testimonials.
